title: Stock SIP basket order file (generic)
when: Intraday, at the SIP placement time
purpose: The day's stock SIP orders for the dealer to upload in the trading front end as a basket (bulk) order file. OMS basket layouts differ (ODIN, NEST and others each have their own): copy this file as stocksip-basket-<oms>.json with the OMS's column names and order, keeping each column's key.

columns.name: Price
columns.note: Limit price; empty for a market order

columns.name: AlgoID
columns.note: Set when the firm tags SIP orders as algo orders

columns.name: Reference
columns.note: The SIP order's reference, for matching the trades back

source: Ledgerline's own generic layout; no OMS vendor's published basket specification was used
linked: Written by Stock SIPs (basket file) for the dealer to upload
